description: Crosswalk a code from one vocabulary to others. Given a code in a source vocabulary (e.g. an ICD-10-CM code), returns the concepts that share the same UMLS CUI in other vocabularies (SNOMED CT, RxNorm, LOINC, etc.). Example: umls_crosswalk({ source: "ICD10CM", code: "I21.9", _apiKey: "your-key" })

code.description: The code within that source vocabulary, e.g. "I21.9"

source.description: Source vocabulary abbreviation (SAB) the code belongs to, e.g. "ICD10CM", "SNOMEDCT_US", "RXNORM", "LNC", "MSH".

name: umls_crosswalk
title: Umls Crosswalk
